lead_line: Russian missile hits Poland  ·  COP31 runs into overtime  ·  Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh

big.headline: Russian missile hits Poland
big.body: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw called it a “provocation” from Moscow, Tusk said. About 2,800 troops from 11 countries were drilling in Poland for a possible post-war Ukraine mission.

big.headline: COP31 runs into overtime with no fossil-fuel deal
big.body: Nearly 200 nations are deadlocked after two weeks of talks in Turkey. The EU warns COP31 risks turning into a “fossil summit” as key climate commitments are missing from the draft deal.

big.headline: Saudi coalition downs Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh
big.body: The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh, the second Houthi attack on the capital in a few days. Iran's IRGC claims it downed a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
